messages:
Ava (Marketing): Quick syncdraft for tri-mode landing pilot. Objective: hosted = fastest-to-start, dedicated = production scale confidence, private = compliance-first. Need short hero lines, a compact benchmark blurb, webinar gating copy, and clear inbound routing.
Diego (Growth): Agreed. Prioritize hero clarity, then benchmark proof, then CTA variants for webinar vs demo.
Priya (Content): Three hero options (6-9 words):
- Hosted: 'Single API to start building  instant results.'
- Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU capacity  predictable production throughput.'
- Private: 'Deploy in your VPC  full control and auditability.'
Sam (Demand Gen): Webinar form should have two tracks: 'Self-serve' -> send recording + onboarding checklist; 'Enterprise walkthrough' -> AE follow-up.
Jordan (Sales Ops): Routing mapping for engineers (simple YAML sketch):
```yaml
incoming_path: /signup
form_fields:
  product_mode: [hosted, dedicated, private]
routing:
  hosted:
    queue: inbound_hosted
    notify: growth@redwood.ai
  dedicated:
    queue: dedicated_sales
    notify: ae@redwood.ai
  private:
    queue: enterprise_ops
    notify: enterprise@redwood.ai
```
Jordan (Sales Ops): Add hidden field 'benchmark_interest=true' when benchmark CTA used. Also auto-assign companies >1000 employees to AE queue.
Ava (Marketing): Benchmark blurbs: we have median P95 90ms on Hosted (short prompts) and ~40% lower per-token cost with Redwood Optimize batching. Draft: 'Real-world P95 90ms  40% lower per-token cost.' Thoughts?
Diego (Growth): Tighten to: 'Real-world P95 90ms  40% lower per-token cost' (use middle dot). Scannable.
Priya (Content): Webinar microcopy: 'Join our workshop: live benchmarks, migration checklist, and an engineering Q&A.' CTA options: 'Save my spot' / 'Request enterprise walkthrough' / 'Watch on demand'.
Sam (Demand Gen): A/B test two hero variants: A) benchmark-first hero + webinar CTA; B) product-first hero + start button. Hypothesis: benchmark-first raises qualified platform signups. I'll own experiment and tracking params: utm_campaign=tri-copy-pilot&utm_variant=bench-hero.
Jordan (Sales Ops): Will build SF routing rules and notify templates. Include queue logic and priority flags.
Priya (Content): Pushed draft to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch-copy-pilot. Comments welcome.
Ava (Marketing): Action items: Priya finalize copy today; Diego set up A/B in Growth stack; Sam wire tracking and experiments; Jordan implement SF routing rules. Copy review at 3pm; if you can't attend, drop comments on Drive. :raised_hands:
lifecycle-bot: New benchmark uploaded: 'hosted-short-prompts-v2' at /benchmarks/hosted-short-prompts-v2. Pinged @Ava @Diego.
Diego (Growth): I'll use that benchmark for variant A.
Sam (Demand Gen): I'll prepare the webinar gating flow and segments (platform, infra, enterprise).
Ava (Marketing): Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the review and finalize the wire for launch.
